sentences.text_target: Tom woke up early because he felt very sick.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm woʊk ʌp ˈɜːrli bɪˈkʌz hi felt ˈvɛri sɪk/
sentences.text_native: Tom s'est réveillé tôt parce qu'il se sentait très malade.

sentences.text_target: He had a bad headache and a high fever.
sentences.phonetic: /hi hæd ə bæd ˈhɛdˌeɪk ænd ə haɪ ˈfiːvər/
sentences.text_native: Il avait un affreux mal de tête et une forte fièvre.

sentences.text_target: He decided to schedule an appointment with his doctor.
sentences.phonetic: /hi dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː ˈʃɛdjuːl ən əˈpɔɪntmənt wɪð hɪz ˈdɑːktər/
sentences.text_native: Il a décidé de prendre rendez-vous avec son médecin.

sentences.text_target: He walked to the medical office in the morning.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːkt tuː ðə ˈmɛdɪkəl ˈɔːfɪs ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Il a marché jusqu'au cabinet médical dans la matinée.

sentences.text_target: He pushed the door and entered the warm room.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pʊʃt ðə dɔːr ænd ˈɛntərd ðə wɔːrm ruːm/
sentences.text_native: Il a poussé la porte et est entré dans la pièce chauffée.

sentences.text_target: The friendly receptionist greeted him with a smile.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfrɛndli rɪˈsɛpʃənɪst ˈɡriːtɪd hɪm wɪð ə smaɪl/
sentences.text_native: La réceptionniste sympathique l'a accueilli avec le sourire.

sentences.text_target: Tom sat on a comfortable chair to wait.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm sæt ɒn ə ˈkʌmfərtəbəl tʃɛr tuː weɪt/
sentences.text_native: Tom s'est assis sur une chaise confortable pour attendre.

sentences.text_target: After a few minutes, the nurse called his name.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈæftər ə fjuː ˈmɪnɪts, ðə nɜːrs kɔːld hɪz neɪm/
sentences.text_native: Après quelques minutes, l'infirmière a prononcé son nom.

sentences.text_target: He followed her down the quiet hallway.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈfɑːloʊd hɜːr daʊn ðə ˈkwaɪət ˈhɔːlweɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il l'a suivie dans le couloir calme.

sentences.text_target: She measured his weight and his height.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi ˈmɛʒərd hɪz weɪt ænd hɪz haɪt/
sentences.text_native: Elle a mesuré son poids et sa taille.

sentences.text_target: Then, she checked his temperature carefully.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn, ʃi tʃɛkt hɪz ˈtɛmprətʃər ˈkɛrfəli/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, elle a vérifié sa température avec attention.

sentences.text_target: The doctor opened the door and welcomed him.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɑːktər ˈoʊpənd ðə dɔːr ænd ˈwɛlkəmd hɪm/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin a ouvert la porte et l'a accueilli.

sentences.text_target: Hello Tom, please sit down and tell me your problem.
sentences.phonetic: /həˈloʊ tɒm, pliːz sɪt daʊn ænd tɛl miː jʊər ˈprɑːbləm/
sentences.text_native: Bonjour Tom, veuillez vous asseoir et me dire ce qui ne va pas.

sentences.text_target: Tom looked tired and began to explain his symptoms.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm lʊkt ˈtaɪərd ænd bɪˈɡæn tuː ɪkˈspleɪn hɪz ˈsɪmptəmz/
sentences.text_native: Tom avait l'air fatigué et a commencé à expliquer ses symptômes.

sentences.text_target: I felt very weak last night.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ felt ˈvɛri wiːk læst naɪt/
sentences.text_native: Je me suis senti très faible la nuit dernière.

sentences.text_target: Sleeping was very hard because of my cough.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsliːpɪŋ wɒz ˈvɛri hɑːrd bɪˈkʌz ʌv maɪ kɔːf/
sentences.text_native: Dormir a été très difficile à cause de ma toux.

sentences.text_target: My nose started running and I sneezed often.
sentences.phonetic: /maɪ noʊz ˈstɑːrtɪd ˈrʌnɪŋ ænd aɪ sniːzt ˈɔːfən/
sentences.text_native: Mon nez a commencé à couler et j'ai souvent éternué.

sentences.text_target: My whole body aches and my throat hurts too.
sentences.phonetic: /maɪ hoʊl ˈbɑːdi eɪks ænd maɪ θroʊt hɜːrts tuː/
sentences.text_native: J'ai des courbatures dans tout le corps et j'ai mal à la gorge aussi.

sentences.text_target: The doctor listened to his chest with a stethoscope.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɑːktər ˈlɪsənd tuː hɪz tʃɛst wɪð ə ˈstɛθəˌskoʊp/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin a ausculté sa poitrine avec un stéthoscope.

sentences.text_target: Take a deep breath and relax.
sentences.phonetic: /teɪk ə diːp brɛθ ænd rɪˈlæks/
sentences.text_native: Prenez une grande inspiration et détendez-vous.

sentences.text_target: He checked his blood pressure very calmly.
sentences.phonetic: /hi tʃɛkt hɪz blʌd ˈprɛʃər ˈvɛri ˈkɑːmli/
sentences.text_native: Il a vérifié sa tension artérielle très calmement.

sentences.text_target: It is not a serious infection.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz nɒt ə ˈsɪriəs ɪnˈfɛkʃən/
sentences.text_native: Ce n'est pas une infection grave.

sentences.text_target: You just have a bad winter virus.
sentences.phonetic: /juː dʒʌst hæv ə bæd ˈwɪntər ˈvaɪrəs/
sentences.text_native: Vous avez simplement un mauvais virus hivernal.

sentences.text_target: The doctor wrote a prescription on a small piece of paper.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɑːktər roʊt ə prɪˈskrɪpʃən ɒn ə smɔːl piːs ʌv ˈpeɪpər/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin a rédigé une ordonnance sur un petit morceau de papier.

sentences.text_target: You need to take this medicine three times a day.
sentences.phonetic: /juː niːd tuː teɪk ðɪs ˈmɛdɪsn θriː taɪmz ə deɪ/
sentences.text_native: Vous devez prendre ce médicament trois fois par jour.

sentences.text_target: Drink a lot of water, hot tea, and warm soup.
sentences.phonetic: /drɪŋk ə lɒt ʌv ˈwɔːtər, hɑːt tiː, ænd wɔːrm suːp/
sentences.text_native: Buvez beaucoup d'eau, du thé chaud et de la soupe chaude.

sentences.text_target: Get plenty of rest for a few days.
sentences.phonetic: /ɡɛt ˈplɛnti ʌv rɛst fɔːr ə fjuː deɪz/
sentences.text_native: Reposez-vous bien pendant quelques jours.

sentences.text_target: Tom paid the consultation fee with his credit card.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm peɪd ðə ˌkɑːnsəlˈteɪʃən fiː wɪð hɪz ˈkrɛdɪt kɑːrd/
sentences.text_native: Tom a payé les frais de consultation avec sa carte bancaire.

sentences.text_target: He walked to the local pharmacy to buy the medicine.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːkt tuː ðə ˈloʊkəl ˈfɑːrməsi tuː baɪ ðə ˈmɛdɪsn/
sentences.text_native: Il a marché jusqu'à la pharmacie du coin pour acheter les médicaments.

sentences.text_target: He went back home, knowing he would recover soon.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɛnt bæk hoʊm, ˈnoʊɪŋ hi wʊd rɪˈkʌvər suːn/
sentences.text_native: Il est rentré chez lui, sachant qu'il guérirait bientôt.
